data.text/markdown:
Week 12: recency in practice

Deliverable: refresh one source, rerun your row counts and one trace, report what changed. Public data is not a fixed thing. CMS refreshes Care Compare on a schedule (the course data mirror's README says quarterly), and every refresh can add or drop hospitals, change numbers, move the reporting period forward, or suppress a value that used to be published. An app built in week 8 can be out of date by week 14 without anyone touching it. This notebook compares two versions of the layer:
  • Earlier: your week-3 export (upload it), or a SIMULATED earlier snapshot the notebook makes for you, so you can practise before any real refresh.
  • Current: the layer rebuilt now from the sources the course loads today.
The real exercise is to run this again after the next refresh with your saved export, and report what actually changed.

data.text/html:
1. Where the current numbers came from

Check the obtained_from and loaded_at columns. If they say local cache, this notebook reused a copy saved earlier in the data folder next to it, not a fresh download. To force a fresh copy, delete that data folder and run again. Then ask your instructor when the course copy of the sources was last refreshed: a fresh download of an old copy is still old.

data.text/markdown:
5. What it means for your app

A diff is a list; your report says what it means. For each kind of change, decide:
  • Period moved forward: your app's labels and your week-5 defense name a period. Are they now wrong?
  • Score changed: is the change bigger than you'd expect from one more quarter of data? Check one hospital against the source page before you believe it.
  • New suppression: a hospital that disappears from your chart has not improved or closed; it lost its number. Does your app say so?
  • Rows added or removed: did your row counts in the app's panel change? They should.
Ask your AI: "Here is the summary of changes between two versions of my data layer: [paste the summary line and the tables]. Draft a half-page 'what changed' note for a hospital manager. List every number you use and which table it came from, so I can check each one." Ask your AI: "My week-3 layer has these extra columns: [paste]. Add them to the checks function in this marimo cell [paste the cell's code], one check per column, and keep the earlier and current columns side by side."

Before you submit

Deliverable: a short "what changed" report: which source you refreshed (with its provenance row), what changed, and what it means for your app. If you used the simulated snapshot, say so. Optional, for more: the full before-and-after checks table. The one check: pick one hospital from "Hospitals whose score changed" (or "New suppression") and confirm the current value on the source page yourself. Human sign-off (three lines in the cell below).
